definitions: Lens types define optical behavior—focal length range, distortion, bokeh, and close-focus—selected to match story distance, movement, and product detail needs.
rules: If subject distance is fixed and look must be consistent, prefer a prime.
Always test facial distortion before committing to ultra-wide close-ups.
When product detail is the story, prioritize macro capability over zoom convenience.
Never change lens mid-setup without checking exposure and framing continuity.
